lines.zh: 我走得很慢，每一步都像在忍。
lines.en: I walk slowly, each step like something endured.

lines.zh: 我的身体东倒西歪，还是往前走。
lines.en: My body lists, and still I advance.
The soil blackens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我比一般的变异体高很多。
lines.en: I stand far taller than the usual mutants.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，停很久才放下。
lines.en: I lift a leg and hold it a long time.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，身上在滴东西。
lines.en: Something drips from me as I walk.
A fence stands in my way; I press through it.
I walk toward that house.
My shadow is long, and crooked.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，都像下了决心。
lines.en: Each step looks like a decision.
I stand, swaying slightly.

lines.zh: 我在生气，但说不清为什么。
lines.en: I am angry, and cannot say why.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西在慢慢长。
lines.en: What is on me grows slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬头，脸已经不太像人了。
lines.en: I raise my head. My face is barely human.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，等到了现在。
lines.en: I waited a long time. Now I am here.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很粗，一顿一顿。
lines.en: My breathing is coarse, uneven.
I count how much is left.

lines.zh: 手指一根根蜷起，又松开。
lines.en: My fingers curl one by one, then let go.
I hate you without needing a reason.
This place is already mine.
I turn my head slowly, scanning.

lines.zh: 低沉的声音从胸口出来。
lines.en: A low sound comes up out of my chest.
Something rolls under my hide.
I am not fully grown.
But this is enough.
I have stood beneath this porch a long while.

lines.zh: 你就站在这里，离我两步。
lines.en: You stand right there, two steps from me.
I hate the way you look.
You are alive and well.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己什么时候变成这样。
lines.en: I do not remember when I became this.
I remember someone running away.
So I stayed.
Retreat. I am watching.
I am two heads above you.
Your hand is going to your pocket.
Nothing you do will help.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，你会发现够不着。
lines.en: I raise a hand. You will find it out of reach.
Stand a little longer.
My body sways, but it does not go down.
That knocked a piece off.
I do not cry in pain. I cry in hate.
My hide splits; things move inside.
Half a step back, my heel braced on the ground.
I was ready for this much.
I watch it closing.
An awkward place to be hit. Clever.
This hand, I know it.
I stopped fearing pain long ago.
I do not eat such things.
I want something else.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给一个怪物。
lines.en: You hold food up to a monster.
What is that supposed to be.

lines.zh: 那是汗，不是能吃的东西。
lines.en: That is sweat, not something to eat.
Put it down and back off.
I am not hungry.
I only want you to change too.
Save it for your last meal.
I need no one to feed me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我也没动。
lines.en: You hit me and I did not move either.

lines.zh: 撞得我偏了偏，脚下没动。
lines.en: The blow tilts me, but my feet do not move.
Make way for me.

lines.zh: 一撞之下，你滑出了好远。
lines.en: One impact slid you a long way.

lines.zh: 撞过来的是你，退的也是你。
lines.en: You are the one who rammed me, and the one who fell back.
Where you touched is sticky.
My hand has not come down and you are already running.
One step closer and I will grab you.
Try shoving me once more.
You have it on you now.

lines.zh: 我已经不是那个东西了。
lines.en: I am no longer that thing.
This tier has no such thing.

lines.zh: 我恨得太多，装不下别的。
lines.en: I hate too much to hold anything else.
My kind only climb higher.
Do not say it beside me.
I remember waiting out a rain.
That person did not wait for me.
So I became this.
Go, and do not look back.
I do not want to hear it.
The stone sits in my hand; I squeeze it once.
One squeeze and it breaks.
I lift a corpse.
It goes soft in my hand.
I fling it aside and it strikes the wall.
I will keep it; it might be worth throwing.
I press it against myself.
It stuck to my hand.
I lift it to my eyes; its shape blurs.
The thing in my hand is still struggling.

lines.zh: 你的手臂刚动，我就动了。
lines.en: Your arm barely moved, and I moved with it.
I have turned my body toward you.
One lifted leg is enough.
My arm rises and hangs in the air.
That little light stands out in the dark.
I hate the light in your hand.
I drag my feet toward you.
You will not like what comes.
I have opened my hand.
The doorway is narrow; you will not squeeze through.
That door will not stop me.
My shadow reaches your feet before I do.
I have waited a long time for this chase.

lines.zh: 你别动，我全身的肉都在认你。
lines.en: Don't move. Every scrap of flesh on me is learning you.
That is very good indeed.
I move, slow enough to frighten.
Do not close your eyes.
Let me look at you properly.
I follow, one foot after the other.
You are not slow.
But I need not stop.
You locked the door.

lines.zh: 门板裂开，木屑落上肩头。
lines.en: The door panel splits and splinters land on my shoulder.
You went upstairs.
The stairs creak badly.
I climb one step at a time.
You are in the corner.
The longer you run, the stronger you smell.
You have raised a chair.
That will not help.
Two more strides.
Your hands are unsteady.
I see you trembling.
I was like that once.
Now it is your turn. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我停一下，让你多站一会儿。
lines.en: I pause, to let you stand a little longer.
One corridor left.
You will not get far. I take my time.
One hand comes down.
That dented the wall.
My fingers dig into the hollow of your shoulder.
The wall is cold against your back.
The arm rises slowly and falls fast.
You blocked it and were pushed back anyway.
Slow to swing, but heavy when it lands.
You fly out and break the window.
I stomp and the floor gives.
That is enough to change you.
Do not fall yet; I am not finished with you.
My hand is up.
This time my hand does not come back.
That finishes it.

lines.zh: 我从很深的地方爬上来。
lines.en: I climb up from somewhere deep.
My first breath is sour.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是一夜长成的。
lines.en: This body did not grow in one night.

lines.zh: 我站直，比周围的树矮不了多少。
lines.en: I straighten. Not much shorter than the trees.

lines.zh: 我抬手，看见自己的手指。
lines.en: I raise a hand and see my fingers.
Not a human hand any more.
I remember waiting.
A long time. Until this.
Everyone around had already fled.
Only me left.
I walk toward the nearest light.
I remember that family's door.
I am going to knock on that door.
I will let them see.
This body runs hot.
I know what comes next.
It is dark now. Time for me to move.
I step out of the dark, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这是最后一次，我这样走路。
lines.en: This is the last time I walk like this.
It is finally my turn.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上冒烟，发出怪味。
lines.en: Fire makes me smoke and stink.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，身体散了一块。
lines.en: I fall, and a piece comes loose.
Water fills me and I sink slowly.
The blast tears off half of me.
Something lodges in me.

lines.zh: 咒力在我体内搅，我很难受。
lines.en: The curse churns inside. It is unbearable.
My empty stomach stopped feeling long ago.
Lightning passes through and I flare.
No ground below; I fall.
